why: The old legacy reference PNG for case_0001 has pixel (712,406) = [207,207,207,207], identical to the input.

Windows runtime trace of the current CPU AEX at the same pixel produced cce0 floats [0.57797289,0.57797289,0.57797289,0.52794117] and final store bytes [135,200,200,200], which premultiply to the Mac candidate [106,106,106,135].

Mac CLI now reproduces the same cce0 stage values for this witness, so the next proof is reference provenance: recapture current Windows Software PNGs before treating the old legacy PNG residual as a porting bug.

inputs.description: Use the same source artwork as refs/win_references/20260605_extra/OLMSmoother2 case_0001 if possible. The before-effects pixel at (712,406) should be [207,207,207,207].

cases.reason: Exact recapture of old legacy case_0001 settings under current Windows Software render. Critical witness pixel: (712,406).
Pass-through control. This should preserve the before-effects pixel [207,207,207,207] at (712,406).

manifest_requirements: Record AE version, project_gpu_accel_type.current_name and raw value.
Record all OLM Smoother v2 property names, match_names, property_index, values, enabled/active state, and selected effect path.
Keep ADBE Force CPU GPU / GPU Rendering as reference-only metadata, not as the execution-path label.
Save both before_effects_frame and effect output PNG for every case.
Record sampled RGBA values at pixel (712,406) for before_effects_frame and output.

If the current_aex output at (712,406) is [106,106,106,135] or close, note that it matches the runtime-traced CPU AEX behavior and supersedes the old legacy case_0001 PNG as a CPU Software reference for this witness.
If the current_aex output remains [207,207,207,207], record any setting/project difference that could explain why runtime trace saw the low-alpha cce0 path.
mac_follow_up: Compare the recaptured Software PNG against the locally reproduced current-AEX witness PNG and refs/win_references/20260605_extra/OLMSmoother2/case_0001.png.
If recapture matches [106,106,106,135] at the witness pixel, downgrade the old legacy reference residual to stale-reference/provenance-blocked instead of a Smoother2 algorithm bug.
